slides.title: Weekend plans
slides.text: Eva and Max have two plans for the weekend. If it's sunny, they'll go to the beach and swim. If it rains, they'll stay home, cook and watch movies. Eva checks the weather every hour. On Saturday morning the sun comes out and they pack their bags. Plan A wins!
slides.pt: Eva e Max têm dois planos, e o sol decide: praia!

items: What will you do if it snows?

slides.title: Presente depois de if
slides.text: Depois de 'if' não use 'will': diga 'If it rains', e não 'If it will rain'. Use will apenas na parte do resultado.

slides.homework: Escreva 8 frases condicionais sobre seus planos.
